chunks: Muḥammad ibn al-Nuʿmān narrated from him, peace be upon him:
that he was asked about a man who broke his fast for one day in the month of Ramaḍān, so he said:
"His expiation is two jarībān of food, and that is twenty ṣāʿs."

key_terms.جَرِيبَانِ: two jarībān; a measured quantity used here for food expiation
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramaḍān, the obligatory month of fasting
key_terms.صَاعًا: a ṣāʿ; a standard measure of volume for food
key_terms.كَفَّارَتُهُ: his expiation; the compensatory penalty due for the violation

ai.seo_question: What is the kaffarah for breaking one fast day in Ramaḍān according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the kaffarah for breaking one day of fasting in the month of Ramaḍān. The Imam عليه السلام states that the expiation is two jarībān of food, clarified here as twenty ṣāʿs.
